components.label: Player body
components.purpose: Multi player, 329 wide × 453 deep × 118 high mm and 5.5 kg, with an aluminium top plate. Two in the inventory.
components.limits: Envelope is published; edge profile and button placement are approximate.

components.label: Jog wheel with centre display
components.purpose: Large jog wheel with an LCD in its centre showing playhead position and artwork. A 206 mm jog is reported; the manual specification table does not state the diameter.
components.limits: Diameter is not in the manual specification table.

components.label: 9-inch touch screen
components.purpose: 9-inch full-colour HD LCD touch screen for browsing, waveforms and settings, with shortcut buttons for Playlist and Search below it.

components.label: Hot Cue and loop buttons
components.purpose: Eight Hot Cue buttons run left to right under the waveform, with dedicated Beat Jump, 4-beat and 8-beat loop controls.

components.label: PLAY/PAUSE and CUE
components.purpose: Redesigned play, cue and Hot Cue buttons on the lower left, with the tempo slider to the right of the jog.

components.label: SD card slot
components.purpose: Front-left SD slot, SD standard file system, up to 32 GB.

components.label: USB type A (top)
components.purpose: USB downstream port for a drive, 5 V / 1 A or less, under the cover on the top-left.

components.label: AUDIO OUT L/R · RCA
components.purpose: Analogue line output, 2.0 Vrms at 1 kHz, 4 Hz – 40 kHz, 115 dB S/N. This is what feeds a mixer line channel.

components.label: DIGITAL OUT · coaxial RCA
components.purpose: Coaxial S/PDIF digital output, 0.5 Vp-p into 75 Ω, 96 kHz / 24 bit, for a mixer digital input.

components.label: LINK · PRO DJ LINK LAN
components.purpose: 1000BASE-T Ethernet for Pro DJ Link: share one USB or SD library across players, sync, and rekordbox link export. A LAN cable ships in the box.

components.label: USB type B (PC/Mac)
components.purpose: USB upstream port for a laptop: HID control of Serato DJ Pro, djay PRO AI or TRAKTOR PRO 3, or rekordbox export.

components.label: AC IN · V-Lock power
components.purpose: IEC mains inlet with the lockable V-Lock cable in regions that ship it, next to the power switch.
components.limits: Voltage and wattage are not on the readable pages; see the manual safety sheet.

components.label: Kensington lock slot
components.purpose: Security slot on the rear for a cable lock.
components.limits: Not in the readable manual pages; common to CDJ players.

page.practice_cards:
Simulated CDJ-3000 state



Connections and controls
Each button only reads back what the manufacturer document says that connector or control does.


Link two players
One LAN cable from each CDJ-3000 to the mixer's LINK ports (or a switch) lets both read one USB stick or SD card and sync. Audio still leaves each player on its own RCA or digital pair.
The DJM-A9 has the LINK hub; this model does not simulate the network.
